verdict.rationale: Exa ships a JS SDK with a ready-made web_search tool for OpenAI/Anthropic agent loops (webSearch() with recommended settings, streamSearch yielding OpenAI-style chunks) plus an official MCP server connecting Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, and 10+ AI assistants to its tools, directly matching function-calling/tool-call and agent-framework integration needs. missing for 10: no evidence of a discoverable OpenAPI schema (probe found 404s) or broader multi-language framework integrations (e.g. LangChain/LlamaIndex) beyond the JS SDK and MCP.
